description: Lists recent Huasheng videos, newest first. With query, searches every project in the account by title or original script, so a result is never limited to one backend page. Returns the newest limit matches; when has_more is true, pass next_cursor back to continue the same result set — but only when the user actually asked for the complete list, since dumping every link into the conversation answers nothing. Use it when the user means some other video and names or describes it, instead of asking them for a 15-digit pid. Do not use it to guess which video they are on right now: it orders by recency, which is not the same thing, so omit pid for the current video. It is read-only; renaming a video uses huasheng_set_style with setting=name.

cursor.description: Opaque next_cursor from a previous call, to continue that same result set. It already carries the query and time window, so do not resend them alongside it.

limit.description: How many videos to return, up to 50; default 20

query.description: Optional title or script text to search across every project

since_days.description: Only consider videos created in the last N days. No default: without it every video in the account is searched. Pass it only when the user asked for a time range.

name: huasheng_list_projects
title: Find Huasheng videos
